headline: Thieves steal crown jewels from the [REDACTED] in a heist lasting minutes
hint: The robbers used a truck-mounted lift to reach a window of the Paris museum's Apollo Gallery.
original: Thieves steal crown jewels from the Louvre in a heist lasting minutes
summary: In October 2025, thieves used a truck-mounted lift to break into the Louvre's Apollo Gallery in Paris and escaped with French crown jewels in a robbery that lasted only minutes.

headline: [REDACTED]-born cardinal Robert Prevost elected as first American pope
hint: The new pope, who took the name Leo XIV, previously served as a missionary and bishop in Peru.
original: Chicago-born cardinal Robert Prevost elected as first American pope
summary: In May 2025, Cardinal Robert Prevost, born in Chicago, was elected pope and took the name Leo XIV, becoming the first pope from the United States.

headline: Fans queue overnight as [REDACTED] craze drives record profits for Pop Mart
hint: The toothy plush monsters are sold in blind boxes, so buyers don't know which one they'll get.
original: Fans queue overnight as Labubu craze drives record profits for Pop Mart
summary: Labubu, a mischievous plush monster sold by Chinese toymaker Pop Mart in blind boxes, became a global collecting craze in 2025.

headline: Magnitude 7.7 earthquake strikes [REDACTED], with shaking felt as far away as Bangkok
hint: Mandalay was among the hardest-hit cities in the Southeast Asian country once known as Burma.
original: Magnitude 7.7 earthquake strikes Myanmar, with shaking felt as far away as Bangkok
summary: In March 2025, a magnitude 7.7 earthquake struck central Myanmar near Mandalay, killing thousands. The shaking toppled a building under construction in Bangkok.

headline: Notre-Dame cathedral in [REDACTED] reopens five years after devastating fire
hint: World leaders attended as the Gothic cathedral, with its rebuilt spire, welcomed visitors again.
original: Notre-Dame cathedral in Paris reopens five years after devastating fire
summary: Notre-Dame de Paris reopened in December 2024, five and a half years after the April 2019 fire that destroyed its roof and spire.

headline: Massive blackout leaves [REDACTED] and Portugal without power
hint: Trains stopped, traffic lights went dark and phone networks failed across the Iberian Peninsula.
original: Massive blackout leaves Spain and Portugal without power
summary: In April 2025, a massive power outage hit the Iberian Peninsula, cutting electricity to most of Spain and Portugal for many hours.

headline: [REDACTED] clinch Premier League title with four games to spare
hint: Arne Slot won the English title in his first season in charge at Anfield.
original: Liverpool clinch Premier League title with four games to spare
summary: Liverpool won the 2024–25 Premier League title in April 2025, sealing it with a win over Tottenham in Arne Slot's first season as manager.

headline: [REDACTED] reunion tour kicks off in Cardiff after 16 years apart
hint: Liam and Noel Gallagher are back on stage together for the first time since their 2009 split.
original: Oasis reunion tour kicks off in Cardiff after 16 years apart
summary: Oasis began their reunion tour in Cardiff in July 2025, the first shows by Liam and Noel Gallagher together since the band split in 2009.

headline: Black Sabbath frontman [REDACTED] Osbourne dies aged 76
hint: The 'Prince of Darkness' died just weeks after a farewell concert in his home city of Birmingham.
original: Black Sabbath frontman Ozzy Osbourne dies aged 76
summary: Ozzy Osbourne, the Black Sabbath singer known as the 'Prince of Darkness', died in July 2025, weeks after a farewell concert in Birmingham.

headline: Athletes sail down the Seine as Paris [REDACTED] open in the rain
hint: The opening ceremony was held along the river rather than in a stadium, a first for the Summer Games.
original: Athletes sail down the Seine as Paris Olympics open in the rain
summary: The Paris 2024 Summer Olympics opened in July 2024 with a ceremony along the River Seine, the first Summer Games opening held outside a stadium.
